title: My cosy Japanese town sim now has a proper tutorial + you can go fishing as your residents
author: Saiss00
selftext:
I posted Komachi here about a week ago. It's a small town builder set on a Japanese island where you draw streets, zone areas, and then mostly sit back and watch people live their lives.

One thing I heard from the last post was that the beginning was pretty confusing, which was fair 😅 So I've been trying to make the first few minutes a lot easier to understand.

There's now a new starting island that guides you through building your first street, homes, shop and workplace. I didn't want a tutorial with a bunch of popups and "next" buttons, so each little prompt just disappears once you've actually done it.

After that you get to watch the first people arrive by train, see the first family move in, and then the tutorial leaves you alone.

I also somehow ended up making a fishing minigame.

If one of your residents is hanging out at the jetty, you can basically take over as them and fish. You strike when something bites, hold to reel in and let go to give the fish some line. If you catch it, your resident proudly holds it up. If it escapes, they look absolutely defeated.

You can also catch an old boot.

There are a few other things I've added too: a smoother opening train ride, photo albums for each town, town export/import and fully keyboard-controlled menus.

There are Windows installer, portable Windows and Linux AppImage versions. Saves are local and I don't collect anything.

Also, since a few people asked last time: Komachi originally launched at $2 as a pre-release price. It's now $4.99. Anyone who already bought it still gets all future updates.

Next thing I'm working on is interiors and letting you furnish them.

I'm especially curious whether the new tutorial actually makes sense to someone who's never played before, so if you try it I'd love to know where you get confused (if anywhere).

  
If you want to build a little island town and watch its residents live their lives, you can play Komachi here: [Play Komachi](https://saiss.itch.io/komachi)
